clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine, Forsaken agents seek shackles worn by Moonrage worgen. Dalar Dawnweaver studies Arugal's notes to learn how the renegade mage strengthened his unstable magic. The bindings may help the Forsaken break the worgen threat.

Dalar Dawnweaver studies Arugal's recovered research with open contempt for his former peer. He says Arugal was never fit to serve Dalaran, much less wield high sorcery in the kingdom's darkest hour. Lacking talent, Arugal turned to enchanted relics and devices to strengthen and bind the worgen he summoned. Dalar needs samples of those objects to study the magic tethering the beasts.

Moonrage worgen roam Silverpine with shackles that carry Arugal's binding enchantments. Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls prowl north and east of the Sepulcher. Their heavy metal shackles hold residual arcane energy, making them useful to Dawnweaver as he searches for a way to counter Shadowfang Keep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed. The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour. Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic. I need to examine these items first hand. Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research. The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal. Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hope I can acquire enough energy from such a limited sample. Perhaps I should have had you get more shackles.
Nonetheless, you showed great skill in collecting these, adventurer.
